parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN $2::boolean THEN bgc.shelf_view($1, 'mine', NULL) END AS own
SELECT bgc.lookup_games($1, $2::jsonb) AS games, CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN bgc.buy_pool($1) END AS pool, bgc.curator_card() AS curator

SELECT x -> 'records' AS records, x ->> 'id' AS id, x ->> 'createdTime' AS "createdTime", x -> 'fields' AS fields, (x ->> 'deleted')::boolean AS deleted FROM (SELECT at.request($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5) AS x) q
